note: Operator ask 2026-10-26 ~17:35Z (manager relay, verbatim in docs/plans/ml-claude-distillation-DESIGN.md § 3.7). PROPOSALS FOR THE OPERATOR (not self-granted; config/mandates.yaml untouched): (a) MD-LIVE-TIGHTEN-SL review_rule (exact YAML in design § 3.7): per action class n>=20 + CI95 of delta_r < 0 => propose recommend-only for that class; > 0 and not OVERCONFIDENT => propose next scope step; tighten_sl/judgement OVERCONFIDENT at n>=10 => propose a judgement_confidence floor.
